title: What are API rate limits?
summary: An API rate limit restricts how many requests a client can send within a specified period. For example: If your AI application sends 150 requests in one minute, the service may reject the additional requests. This commonly produces HTTP 429.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
An API rate limit restricts how many requests a client can send within a specified period.

For example:

```text
100 requests per minute
```

If your AI application sends 150 requests in one minute, the service may reject the additional requests.

This commonly produces HTTP 429.
